title: Bound independent archive authentication workers without changing validation or budgets
description: Bound independent archive authentication workers without changing validation or budgets
no_spec_change_rationale: CI execution scheduling only. Every native history inventory and authenticated-history obligation, exact SpecSync version, before/after read-only guard, 90-second command timeout and 10-minute job budget remain unchanged. No runtime contract or evidence rewrite.
acceptance_criteria: Every historical roster snapshot and archive obligation is retained. Independent current-root archive status reads use a fixed maximum of two workers. Every result must match its requested ID, archived state and authenticated-history validity; no success until all finish. Native errors, invalid archives and command deadlines fail closed. SpecSync 6.1.2, 90-second subprocess timeout, output bounds, read-only fingerprints and the 10-minute hosted job budget stay unchanged. Existing native fixtures plus concurrency/failure/drain tests pass. Actual hosted duration is observed before merge.

answers.constraints: Preserve all historical/native obligations and validations, serial history checkout, exact published SpecSync 6.1.2, existing 90-second subprocess/output bounds and 10-minute hosted job budget, join current-root reads before the final readonly fingerprint, no evidence/archive rewrites, no changes outside the two declared Python files plus native/Chough lifecycle records.
